name: What US state bars charge, and require, to file or review lawyer advertising
description: What each US state bar asks of a lawyer who advertises: whether ads or solicitations must be filed or reviewed, when, the standard, late and advisory fees, the portal or method, whether an expedited review exists, and how long copies must be kept, and, where a bar states it, how many ads it reviews in a year. Every recorded field is backed by a short quote from the bar's or court's own rule or page, with the date read.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). What US state bars charge, and require, to file or review lawyer advertising (Version 3.1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24184382

distribution.name: filing.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: filing.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: filing-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in filing-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to filing.csv on id.

recordSet.name: filing
recordSet.description: The records of What US state bars charge, and require, to file or review lawyer advertising, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: category
field.description: Filing category: files_ads, files_solicitations_only, voluntary_review_only, no_filing or unknown

field.name: filing_required
field.description: yes, no, solicitations_only, voluntary_only or unknown

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
